items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Dick Tila(?), who finally committed suicide. He was a good friend of a trombone player of mine...

ctx.x: No. Paul Baron was the director of the orchestra.... I mean, the producer of the show, Dick Tila(?), who finally committed suicide. He was a good friend of a trombone player of mine who was a very good player that didn't...he got killed in that accident with the Barnet(?) thing... Lloyd Hundley. You ever hear of him?
